meta.description: 全戦略の定義・パラメータ・成績・判定を管理するレジストリ

strategies.name: VolReg_opt
strategies.description: Vol compression (short_vol < long_vol * 0.8) + EMA crossover direction. Daily TF.
strategies.status_reason: Permutation p=0.0416 + bootstrap CI excludes zero + inverse test TRUE_EDGE. DSR fails at 7000 trials. Only 22 OOS trades - needs data accumulation.
strategies.recommendation: Paper trade. Deploy real capital after 50+ OOS trades confirmed.
strategies.auditor_notes: First strategy to pass permutation test among 9500+ trials. Genuine vol-compression edge on DOGE daily. Limited by sample size.

plateau_analysis.verdict: MASSIVE parameter plateau. 95.1% positive across 69K combos = genuine edge, not parameter-specific.

strategies.name: Regime_V3
strategies.description: 20-day return + 20-day realized vol regime classification (bull/bear/high_vol/neutral) + EMA(12/26) crossover direction. RSI mean-reversion in high-vol regime. Daily TF.
strategies.status_reason: Permutation p=0.015 (best in project). Bootstrap CI [1.37, 4.21] excludes zero. 6/10 multi-symbol positive (best generalization). DSR fails at 11K trials. 27 OOS trades still limited.
strategies.recommendation: Paper trade alongside VolReg_opt. Partially independent signal (corr 0.37). Combined with VolReg consensus could reduce variance.
strategies.auditor_notes: Second strategy to pass permutation test. Stronger p-value and better multi-symbol generalization than VolReg_opt. Regime-based approach captures DOGE daily vol dynamics differently from simple vol compression ratio.

strategies.name: VolReg_4h
strategies.description: Vol compression (short_vol < long_vol * threshold) + EMA crossover direction. 4H TF. Two configs: C1 DOGE-specific, C2 generalizing.
strategies.status_reason: Config1: perm p=0.000, WF 4/4, bootstrap CI excludes zero, inverse gap 4.44. Config2: perm p=0.022, WF 4/4, 4/5 multi-symbol positive. 4H plateau 82.3% OOS positive. Same vol-compression mechanism as daily VolReg at higher frequency.
strategies.recommendation: Paper trade alongside daily strategies. Config2 for multi-symbol deployment, Config1 for DOGE-only.
strategies.auditor_notes: Third strategy to pass. Extends daily VolReg edge to 4H. Config1 shows declining WF (4.43→0.96) suggesting alpha decay — monitor closely. Config2 more robust across symbols but weaker on DOGE.

strategies.name: ATR_Ratio_Compression
strategies.description: ATR-based volatility compression (ATR_short/ATR_long < threshold) with EMA crossover. INDEPENDENT from rolling-std VolReg (Pearson 0.08, Jaccard 0.054). Detects price-range compression vs VolReg's return-volatility compression.
strategies.status_reason: Independent from VolReg (Pearson 0.08). 3/4 §5 gates passed. Bootstrap CI excludes zero, 5/5 multi-symbol positive (best in project), inverse gap 3.88. WF fold 2 failure (-3.66) is regime-specific vulnerability. Permutation p=0.01.
strategies.recommendation: Paper trade on all 5 symbols. Monitor fold-2-type regimes. Consider combining with VolReg_4h for portfolio diversification (independent signals).
strategies.auditor_notes: Fourth strategy to pass. First genuinely independent signal family (ATR range vs std ratio). Best multi-symbol result in project (5/5 positive, 4/5 > 0.5). WF fold 2 failure suggests a specific regime vulnerability — may benefit from regime filter. IS→OOS ratio 2.04x is borderline but acceptable given other evidence.

strategies.name: ATR_Ratio_AVAX
strategies.description: ATR compression (atr_short/atr_long < 0.6) + EMA crossover direction. 4H TF on AVAX.
strategies.status_reason: Full anti-overfit pipeline passed: perm p=0.012, WF 4/4 positive (mean 2.17), bootstrap CI [0.195, 1.082] excludes zero, inverse -2.355. Same ATR_Ratio mechanism proven on DOGE/LINK/SOL now validated on AVAX. Expands portfolio diversification.
strategies.recommendation: Add to multi-symbol ATR_Ratio portfolio. Apply sl_cooldown_bars=50 + atr_sl_mult=2.0 for DD management.

strategies.name: SampEn_DOGE_4H
strategies.description: Rolling sample entropy (m=2, r=0.2σ) over 50-bar window detects low-entropy (high-regularity) regimes. Low entropy = predictable microstructure forming. EMA(14/60) for direction. Fundamentally different from volatility compression — measures time-series regularity, not volatility level.

bootstrap.verdict: MARGINAL — 96.1% positive, lower tail barely crosses zero

triple_ensemble.verdict: PASS — adds +0.44 Sharpe to existing ensemble

strategies.status_reason: 6 validation gates: 4 PASS, 2 MARGINAL. WF 4/4 positive (avg 2.05). Inverse gap 5.13 — strongest directional edge in project. Independence confirmed: Pearson <0.05 vs both VolReg and ATR_Ratio. DOGE-specific (1/4 multi-symbol). Bootstrap 96.1% positive but CI lower bound -0.30.
strategies.recommendation: Deploy on DOGE 4H only. Add to triple ensemble (SampEn∪VolReg∪ATR) for +0.44 improvement. Apply sl_cooldown overlay for DD management.
strategies.auditor_notes: First non-compression signal to pass validation. Measures time-series regularity (entropy) rather than volatility level (compression). Genuinely orthogonal to all existing signals. DOGE-only concentration risk accepted — entropy microstructure may be token-specific. Strongest inverse gap in project (5.13) indicates robust directional content.

rejected.name: 8H Compression (VolReg + ATR + OR)
rejected.reason: 12,084 configs (resampled 4H→8H). 11,019 valid, 82% reversal rate (vs 4H 30-50%), median OOS 0.040. 79 'genuine edges' but concentrated in SUI(48)+DOGE(31) only — XRP/LINK/SOL negative. 12.2% annual cost drag. 8H sits between 1H failure and 4H success, much closer to failure side.

rejected.name: Multi-TF Entry (Daily Regime + 4H Entry)
rejected.reason: 720 configs. 60% improved OOS vs baseline, but 65% trade reduction kills statistical power. Only 2/161 perm-sig: SUI p=0.042 (29 trades), DOGE p=1.0 (6 trades). Daily filter helps weak baselines (DOGE, LINK) by avoiding bad regimes, but not a standalone edge. Risk-reduction layer, not alpha generator.

rejected.name: Exit Optimization (ATR SL/TP, Trailing, BE, MaxHold)
rejected.reason: 222 configs on 3 signals. ATR_Ratio: baseline OOS 2.655→2.890 with atr_sl=1.5/atr_tp=4.0/period=21 (+0.235 Sharpe, -1% DD). VolReg_4h and OR_Ensemble negative OOS without exits (-1.034, -0.565) — exits are part of their edge. Trailing stops destroy all signals (-0.81 to -1.37 mean impact). Max-hold inert. Not a new edge but confirms: ATR_Ratio is most robust (edge survives exit removal), trailing stops incompatible with compression.

rejected.name: Cross-Asset BTC Filter
rejected.reason: 400 configs. BTC_LOW_VOL is only useful filter (11/12 improvements). DOGE ATR 2.86→3.44 (+0.58), SOL VolReg 1.56→2.7 (+1.14). But only helps 2/8 already-strong combos. BTC_BULL counterproductive. BTC_HIGH_VOL = trade reduction noise. Not a universal cross-asset edge, modest filter on existing winners. Not worth added complexity.

rejected.name: Volume Signals (OBV, VolBreakout, VWAP, VolComp+Vol)
rejected.reason: 455 configs. 4 perm-sig (SOL/SUI only) but IS Sharpe 0.003-0.537 = weak IS. Best: SOL VolComp+Vol OOS 2.099, IS 0.164 — IS→OOS divergence suggests OOS regime luck. 455 trials × 0.05 = ~23 false positives expected; 4 survivors after IS filter ≈ random chance. OBV divergence: 0 sig. VWAP: 0 sig. Volume not an independent edge.

rejected.name: Correlation Regime (ALT-BTC, CorrBreakout, Cross-ALT)
rejected.reason: 456 configs. 12 perm-sig but ALL in narrow param cluster (corr_window=20, lookback=10) = fragile overfit. SUI dominant but baseline already strong (2.031→2.6, +0.5 only). LINK: IS-negative→OOS-positive = reversal red flag despite p=0.01. Cross-ALT (DOGE anchor): 0 results. 12/456=2.6% ≈ 5% FP rate. Not a robust independent edge.

rejected.name: Seasonality (DoW, Session, MonthEnd)
rejected.reason: 245 configs. 2 perm-sig (SOL exclude-Friday p=0.0075) but 0 Bonferroni-significant (threshold 0.0014 for 245 tests). Thursday worst day across all 5 symbols but not individually significant after correction. 24/7 crypto market lacks persistent temporal patterns. No seasonal filter improves compression signals.

rejected.name: DD Management Overlays (EqMA, DDThrottle, MDE, VolLev, SL-Cooldown)
rejected.reason: 41 configs. SL-specific cooldown is the BEST overlay: sl_cooldown_bars=50, atr_sl_mult=2.0, atr_sl_period=14. ATR_Ratio: Sharpe 2.90→3.87, DD -16.8%→-10.1%, Calmar 4.86. OR Ensemble: flipped from -0.40→+0.35. Consistent across all signals. DDThrottle best raw DD cut (68%) but kills returns. VolLev inert at 1x. MDE causes whipsaw. NOT a new edge but a validated risk management layer.
rejected.note: RISK_MANAGEMENT_FINDING — apply sl_cooldown_bars=50 + atr_sl_mult=2.0 to all deployed strategies

rejected.name: New Symbol Deep Validation (BNB/AVAX/ADA ATR_Ratio)

All daily TF: fail (0 perm-sig for BNB/ADA, WF fails for AVAX). atr_long=42 dominates all candidates.
rejected.note: AVAX promoted to CONDITIONAL_PASS as 5th strategy

rejected.name: Entropy & Complexity (Shannon, SampEn, Higuchi FD)
rejected.reason: 3,160 configs. Shannon 4H/1d: 0 perm-sig. Higuchi FD: 0 perm-sig (median OOS -0.84). Entropy+Compression combo: 0. Sample Entropy DOGE 4H: 8 perm-sig (OOS 2.01-2.88, IS 1.29-1.67, 69-91 trades) — IS consistent, single param cluster (m=2, r_mult=0.2, apen_window=50, ema_slow=60). Low corr with VolReg (Pearson 0.163, Jaccard 0.209). DOGE-only concentration risk. PENDING full validation (WF, bootstrap, inverse).
rejected.note: SampEn DOGE 4H PROMOTED to 6th survivor (CONDITIONAL_PASS). Shannon/Higuchi remain rejected.

rejected.name: Spectral/Frequency-Domain (FFT DominantCycle, SpectralEntropy, WaveletEnergy)

Cyclical structure does not predict 4H crypto direction.

rejected.name: Microstructure Candlestick (BodyShadow, ClosePosition, RangeContraction)

RangeContraction: 22 perm-sig (14 DOGE, 8 SUI), BUT IS→OOS reversal pattern (IS 0.5-1.0 vs OOS 1.8-2.4), low trade counts (10-21 OOS), 0 on SOL. ATR独立 (r=0.10). rejected.note: RangeContraction marginally interesting but IS→OOS reversal pattern + low trades = not promoted

rejected.name: Volatility-of-Volatility (VolOfVol)
rejected.reason: 6,480 configs. 4,175 passed IS filter but 0 met healthy criteria (IS>0.5 AND OOS>1.0 AND ratio<3). Vol-of-vol (rolling std of rolling std) partially correlates with VolReg (r=0.34) — captures same regime instability from a noisier angle. Second-order volatility adds noise without adding signal. Not independent enough to matter, not strong enough to stand alone.

rejected.name: Cross-Asset Momentum (BTC-relative)
rejected.reason: 1,620 configs. 568 passed IS filter but 0 healthy. ALT outperformance vs BTC as signal = no predictive power. BTC momentum state irrelevant for ALT direction at 4H. Cross-asset momentum exists at macro scales (weekly+) but 4H funding-aligned cycles are coin-specific, not BTC-driven.

rejected.name: Parkinson Volatility Ratio
rejected.reason: 8,640 configs. 1,450 healthy, 30 passed strict filter — BUT correlation with ATR_Ratio = 0.87 (DOGE), 0.84 (SUI), 0.89 (SOL). Parkinson uses log(H/L)² which is mathematically equivalent to ATR range-based measurement. All 30 survivors are DOGE (26) + SUI (4), same pattern as ATR_Ratio. Best OOS 4.765 with IS 1.196 = suspicious IS→OOS jump (ratio 0.25). Redundant with existing ATR_Ratio survivor — not an independent edge.
rejected.note: REDUNDANT — Parkinson ≈ ATR_Ratio (r=0.87). 'Different math, same information.'

rejected.name: Autocorrelation / OU Half-Life / Directional Accuracy / Price Acceleration
rejected.reason: 1,188 configs across 4 families. 0 perm-significant, 0 multi-symbol healthy. Autocorrelation: IS→OOS reversal (IS 0.31→OOS -1.06). OU Half-Life: SUI/SOL OOS bias, DOGE p=0.106. DirAccuracy: best p=0.144. PriceAccel: extreme IS overfit (IS 1.85→OOS -0.03). Serial dependence, mean-reversion speed, trend consistency, and momentum acceleration all fail on 4H crypto.
